title: The Sealed Book
paragraphs: A mystery and horror anthology in which the Keeper of the Book opens a sealed volume to reveal standalone tales of murder, greed, revenge, and the supernatural.

Mystery/horror anthology with Phillip Clarke as The Keeper of the Book. Program-number evidence corrects two frozen dates additively and documented Mysterious Traveler same-script relationships are retained.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: 26-program Mutual run (March 18, 1945 to September 9, 1945) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include David Kogan (writer, producer, and director), Jock MacGregor (director and producer), Robert A. Arthur (writer and producer), Phillip Clarke (host), Carl Caruso (announcer), Carl Emory (performer), and Don Randolph (performer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] and [[org|org.666407112636e085|Michelson]].

The stories often return to mystery and suspense, death, murder and mortal danger, fate, foreknowledge and doom, houses, rooms and domestic danger, ghosts and supernatural threat, and identity, faces and the past.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Mutual mystery anthology, Keeper of the Book framing device, Script reuse with The Mysterious Traveler, and Reference tracks alongside historical broadcasts.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|the-mysterious-traveler|The Mysterious Traveler]], [[show|words-at-war|Words at War]], [[show|the-shadow|The Shadow]], [[show|cbs-radio-mystery-theater|CBS Radio Mystery Theater]], and [[show|let-george-do-it|Let George Do It]].
